messages:
sara: quick brain-dump — proposal to detect cross-region KV cache evictions by correlating tenant QPS signatures with short canary spikes and refill latency. we can surface billing-impact flags when traffic falls back to another region. :thinking:

Dmitri: sounds useful. can you sketch the minimal signals we need? miss ratio, refill-rt, and upstream model calls routed to fallback?

sara: exactly. minimal set: 1) per-tenant 1s QPS series, 2) KV miss ratio (prefix and full-key), 3) refill token latency (time from miss->first token), 4) route-hit counts by region, 5) consent flag on tenant (legal residency).

kevin: how do we avoid false positives from normal traffic bursts? we should compare signature shape not just absolute QPS. e.g., short top-hat spike vs sustained ramp.

sara: agreed. plan: emit controlled canary (5s top-hat at 200 qps) for a subset of tenants (canary list) and compute normalized cross-correlation between regions. high asymmetry + high miss ratio -> eviction likely.

maria: two quick concerns: 1) billing visibility — if fallback triggers non-resident region we need per-tenant billing tags; 2) privacy/legal — we need to gate canary for consent-restricted tenants.

sara: yes — canary only for non-consent tenants. and we tag any routed tokens with metadata: {"billing_route":"region-b","eviction_probe":"true"}. simple header passthrough to billing.

kevin: can we get a sample config for the canary to review?

sara: pasted a draft canary config below:

```json
{
  "name": "eviction-probe-v1",
  "tenants": "canary-set-1",
  "duration_s": 5,
  "shape": "top-hat",
  "qps": 200,
  "measurements": ["kv_miss_ratio","refill_latency_ms","route_counts"],
  "emit_billing_tag": true
}
```

Dmitri: nice. will need to make sure probes are rate-limited by host/cluster so we don't impact SLOs. also add a random jitter window.

kevin: telemetry note — add a derived metric: region_asymmetry_score = abs(route_share_regionA - route_share_regionB) / total_routes. combine with miss ratio to compute eviction_score. thresholding can be tuned from historical sim.

maria: how do we handle tenants that are consented and we cannot probe? we still want detection but without active probes. maybe passive heuristics from real traffic shape + increases in refill latency?

sara: passive path: watch for sudden rises in refill_latency_ms and orphaned model calls (calls made to region X but model tokens served from region Y). less confident, so mark as "suspected-eviction" not confirmed.

ops-bot: deploy-plan suggestion: roll probe to 2% of non-consent tenants -> collect 24h -> run automated classifier against known eviction incidents -> expand.

kevin: can we run a backfill on last 30 days to calibrate thresholds? use known incidents (from incident DB) to label positives/negatives and fit classifier.

Dmitri: ops question — when eviction_score trips, what's the operator action? automated rollback? alert to oncall?

sara: initial plan: 1) generate paging alert to routing-oncall + residency team, 2) emit per-tenant billing flag for queued billing reconciliation, 3) create a gold log entry for forensic replay. no automatic traffic changes until we trust classifier (>95% precision).

maria: +1 to manual triage at first. also add an automated snapshot of KV ownership metadata to the alert so operator sees last lease holders.

kevin: one more: expose a simple UI table in console showing eviction_score, last_probe_ts, routes_by_region, billing_impact_estimate. help SRE/product triage.

sara: yep, we'll add a small console widget — wireframe in follow-up.

Dmitri: nit — use timezone-normalized timestamps in logs and include probe-id in request headers so we can filter on log ingestion easily.

maria: privacy/legal check: I'll ask compliance to sign off on the probe tag payload and the canary tenant selection. will update here. :thumbsup: 

sara: thanks. next steps I can take: 1) implement probe runtime shim (routing + billing header), 2) small worker to schedule canaries + compute eviction_score, 3) backfill/calibration job, 4) console widget stub. planning to open RFC PR by EOW.

kevin: runbook draft after we have initial telemetry. otherwise looks good to me.

Dmitri: +1. ping me when RFC PR is up, I'll review the operator bits.

ops-bot: noted — created ticket RN-4821 in routing backlog for probe runtime shim.

sara: cool — thanks team, will post RFC link once PR is open.
